title: Found Unconscious
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} presents found unconscious with cherry-red skin, bitter almond breath odor (only 40% can detect), high anion gap metabolic acidosis, and elevated lactate. Cyanide inhibits cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV of ETC) → blocks oxidative phosphorylation → cells cannot use oxygen → tissue hypoxia despite normal PaO2 → anaerobic metabolism → lactic acidosis. Sources: smoke inhalation (burning plastics/wool), industrial exposure, sodium nitroprusside infusion. Treatment: hydroxocobalamin (Cyanokit — first-line, binds cyanide to form cyanocobalamin which is renally excreted). Alternative: sodium nitrite + sodium thiosulfate (older regimen, risk of methemoglobinemia). Supportive: 100% oxygen, airway management, IVF, vasopressors if needed. Admit to ICU.
